text: Members Home / Members Principal Investigator Abdoulaye Ndao Associate Professor, Senior Member of National Academy of Inventors, African Academy of Sciences Fellow, Sloan Research Fellow (Physics), Scialog Fellow, and Hellman Fellow Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering, UC San Diego a1ndao@ucsd.edu Dr. Ndao is a recipient of numerous prestigious awards, including: 2026 Kavli Fellow National Academy of Science 2026 Senior Member of National Academy of Inventors 2026 African Academy of Sciences Fellow 2026 CMRR Faculty Fellow 2025 Scialog Fellow : Advancing Bioimaging Award 2025 African Materials Research Society (African MRS) Board Member 2024 Sloan Fellowship in Physics 2024 Hellman Fellowship 2024 iCANX Young Scientist Award 2024 IAAM Scientist Medal Lecture 2024 Jacobs School Early Career Faculty Development Award, UC San Diego 2023 Beckman Young Investigator Award, Arnold & Mabel Beckman Foundation 2023 Boston University ECE Outstanding Teaching Award 2023 Scialog: Advancing Bioimaging Award 2022 Sculpted Light in the Brain Innovation Grant 2022 Scialog: Advancing Bioimaging Award 2022 Boston University ECE Outstanding Faculty Committee Service Award 2021 Reidy Family Career Development Professorship – “The very best young faculty” 2021 Rising Star of Light, Nature’s Light: Science and Applications journal 2020 Top 50 Chemistry and Materials Sciences Articles 2018 Best Oral Presentation, 6th Annual UC San Diego Postdoctoral Research Symposium 2018 Gordon Research Travel Grant 2017 Physics World Top Ten Breakthrough – First Topological Laser 2017 Triton Innovation Challenge Grand Prize – Lidar Applications 2017 Prize Winner, Institute for the Global Entrepreneur at UC San Diego 2014 Ph.D. with Honors – Jury’s Congratulations 2011–2014 Ministry Research Fellowship His research interests span a wide range of topics in photonics, material sciences, and physics.
